def _soft_max(vals, temp=1.0):
    """Smooth approximation of max using log-sum-exp."""
    vals = np.asarray(vals)
    if vals.size == 0:
        return 0.0
    max_val = np.max(vals)
    if max_val < -100 * temp:
        return max_val
    exp_vals = np.exp((vals - max_val) / temp)
    return max_val + temp * np.log(np.sum(exp_vals))
